ns2:section.sectionText: Students registered in this lecture must also register for an AQ discussion section. AQ discussion sections are offered in-person or are held synchronously through Zoom at their assigned times and days. Times and days listed for AL1/AL2 lectures are used to hold exams and optional live problem-solving sessions. All lecture material is pre-recorded as videos for students to watch asynchronously. Students are expected to complete online assignments as outlined in the course syllabus. Synchronous help sessions will be open to all students.
